default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1128.title: Fair-value-gap retest follow
E-1128.hypothesis: A three-bar gap (bar j low above the high two bars before) marks one-sided aggressive flow; a later pullback into the gap that closes back out in the gap's direction means the late side is still absent.

E-1129.title: Prior-session VWAP hold-cross follow
E-1129.hypothesis: Yesterday's closing VWAP is the average cost of the last session's participants; a sustained close above/below it shows which side holds the better average today.

E-1130.title: Efficiency-ratio onset follow
E-1130.hypothesis: When net displacement becomes a large share of path length (Kaufman efficiency), a directional participant is working an order; follow the first bar where efficiency crosses the threshold.

E-1131.title: Wick-pressure imbalance follow
E-1131.hypothesis: Persistently longer lower wicks than upper wicks mean sellers are repeatedly absorbed by passive buyers; the imbalance crossing a threshold signals who is on the other side of the tape.

E-1132.title: Shrinking-body run exhaustion fade
E-1132.hypothesis: A run of same-colour bars whose bodies keep shrinking after a big first bar shows momentum buyers (or sellers) running out of follow-through; fade it.

E-1133.title: VWAP slope acceleration follow
E-1133.hypothesis: A session VWAP rising faster than usual with price above it means volume-weighted cost is migrating up; position takers on the wrong side must chase.

E-1134.title: Closing-hour VWAP stretch fade
E-1134.hypothesis: In the last hour intraday day-traders flatten toward the day's average; a stretch from VWAP larger than usual in that window tends to be unwound by position squaring.

E-1135.title: Volume dry-up then expansion bar follow
E-1135.hypothesis: After a stretch of well below-normal volume, one bar of heavy volume with a clear colour is the first sign of an informed participant entering a thin book; follow it.

E-1136.title: Prior-range measured-move fade
E-1136.hypothesis: A move from the previous close equal to a fraction of yesterday's whole range is a move the market rarely sustains without news; fade the first touch of that distance.

E-1137.title: Closing-flow volume surge follow
E-1137.hypothesis: Heavy-volume, full-bodied bars in the last 1-2 hours come from institutions needing to finish orders before the close; follow the direction of that urgency.
